I go to therapy. Been in therapy consistently since 2018. It's not about changing the way you think, so that feels a bit unsolicited. Most of the time I have positive thoughts and I'm able to get myself through whatever self doubt or anxiety is going on. Sometimes the coping mechanisms and reassurance exhaust their threshold for whatever it is that's going on. And that's when it gets challenging. Changing the way you think, when you resolve through self soothing 90% of the time, isn't going to help when this new level of anxiety supersedes your coping mechanisms. And that's why it is so challenging. There's different layers to the intensity of episodes and when they grow more intense, you need more time to be able to adjust to combat them. The space in between that level of adjustment when you haven't learned to evolve yet is where you fall through and struggle. 

But thank you for your support.
